cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(auv_stage6ds LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
enable_testing()
find_package(ompl 2.0.2 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED)
# Build unchanged6DR tests/probe in a new tree; do not edit their source or outputs.
add_subdirectory(../stage6dr frozen6dr)
add_executable(auv6ds_runner runner.cpp)
add_executable(auv6ds_identity_tests identity_tests.cpp)
foreach(target auv6ds_runner auv6ds_identity_tests)
    target_include_directories(${target} PRIVATE ../stage6c)
    target_include_directories(${target} SYSTEM PRIVATE ${STAGE6DR_JSON_INCLUDE})
    target_link_libraries(${target} PRIVATE auv6dr_frozen_model ompl::ompl)
    target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
    if(MINGW)
        target_link_libraries(${target} PRIVATE psapi)
    endif()
endforeach()
if(MINGW)
    target_link_options(auv6ds_runner PRIVATE -municode)
endif()
add_test(NAME actual_planner_pitch_identity COMMAND auv6ds_identity_tests)
